taskContracts.objective: Define the P67 implementation contract only; no mutation behavior.

inputs.narrowScope: Define the P67 implementation contract only; no mutation behavior.
safetyRules: Do not enable project mutation, provider dispatch, tool execution, worker execution, automatic source apply, DB writes, deploy, release, external network calls, or provider spend.
P67 starts with NEXUS OS mutation planning only; project source files remain forbidden unless a later explicit phase allows them.
Patch previews must be reviewable, scoped, evidence-linked, approval-aware, rollback-aware, and non-executing.
Primary UX must not expose raw JSON, raw logs, raw private project IDs, fake runnable apply actions, or DemoApp outside demo mode.

reuseCheck.rule: Reuse existing result, redaction, report, mode guard, phase status, Command Center, and controlled implementation patterns; do not duplicate helpers.

uxUpdate.scope: No Command Center page behavior changes in this subphase unless explicitly listed.
uxUpdate.required: UX must show mutation intent, current state, allowed files, forbidden files, diff preview state, blockers, approval state, owner capability, evidence/activity location, rollback posture, and next action.

dataShapes: intentId, scope, targetKind, allowedFiles, forbiddenFiles, diffPreview, approvalRequired, approvalState, rollbackPlan, mutationAllowed, projectMutationAllowed, executionAllowed, disabledReason, blockers, evidenceRefs, activityRefs, nextAction

inputs.commandCenterUxRequirements: Command Center must show mutation intent, current state, disabled apply state, allowed files, forbidden files, diff preview state, blockers, approval state, owner capability, evidence/activity location, rollback posture, and next action without raw JSON, raw logs, raw private IDs, fake runnable apply actions, or DemoApp leakage.
playwrightTests: No new Playwright route is required unless UX labels change; future P67 UX must cover disabled apply actions, no raw dumps, dark/light/system themes, sidebar navigation, and route-wide safety tests.
testsCheckers: Add or keep P67-specific checker coverage for this subphase.
Keep backend/kernel behavior covered by checker scripts.
checkerUpdates: Keep check:os-phase-status and check:phase-validation-coverage aligned after P67 subphases are added.
docsRoadmap: Add or update P67 implementation plan doc.
Update NEXUS platform roadmap and OS phase status.
inputs.phaseStatusUpdate: Mark P67 in_progress, mark P67.1 complete after validation, and set nextPhase to P67.2.
finalSafetyChecks: Confirm project mutation, provider dispatch, tool execution, worker execution, automatic source apply, DB writes, deploy, release, network calls, and provider spend were not enabled.
Confirm no projects/** files changed.
Confirm no fake working apply actions were exposed.
Confirm primary UX does not expose raw JSON, raw logs, DemoApp leakage, or raw private IDs.

acceptanceCriteria: P67.1 is independently commit-ready.
